{"content":[{"id":"ea2022d1-4063-e6c9-0c26-634b76a22a66","summary":{"name":"Jacques","description":"Hey, we’re JACQUES! A global creative agency with curiosity in our hearts and healthcare in our souls—and we're hell-bent on dreaming up new ways to make the world a healthier place.  

Part of the Havas Health Network, our agency was born on the 90th birthday of one of the world’s most famous living ad legends, our namesake, Jacques Séguéla, and his inimitable spirit lives in all of us.  

Equal parts artiste, maverick, and empath, Jacques created 1500+ campaigns over 55 years to become one of the most awarded creatives in the world.  

But before he took the advertising world by storm, Jacques became a doctor of pharmacology, and like his father who was a physician and his mother who was the first female surgeon in France, he truly embraced the world of medicine and health.  

Mixing ideas and health comes naturally to JACQUES, because like Jacques says, “Creativity Heals Everything”.  

So that’s what we’re here to do: ferociously chase the endless possibilities at the intersection of creativity and health.  

We’re obsessed with creating modern brand experiences and brand content—far beyond tradition—that will help brands and people thrive like never before.  

Because we believe in ideas that bring health to all, not just health to some. 

WE’VE GOT THE GOODS 

There’s nothing more important than people’s health. So we’ve assembled over 500 ambitious empaths across 5 cities who wield deep healthcare expertise, use data as storytelling fuel, and insist on bold thinking to uncomplicate the complicated. 

WE’VE GOT THE GUTS 

Our insatiable spirit to ask, “Why not?” is a beacon for talent and clients who dream of the indescribable, rewarding impact they can have by creating new ways to push the healthcare industry forward, improve people’s lives—and make brands famous.","type":"PUBLIC_COMPANY","industry":"advertising services","staff":{"total":200,"range":{"start":501,"end":1000}},"logo":{"source":"https://images.ai-ark.com/hCuOF18a7xitYlwXnCp1d59_8EZ57jlIfx_g9zYT4pg/exp:1785628799/rs:fill:80:80/plain/s3://ark-company/images/ea2022d1-4063-e6c9-0c26-634b76a22a66.jpg"}},"link":{"website":"https://www.jacques.com","domain":"jacques.com","domain_ltd":"havas.com","linkedin":"https://www.linkedin.com/company/tonic-havasworldwide-com"},"financial":{"revenue":{"annual":{"start":10000000,"end":25000000,"amount":"10000000-25000000"}}},"location":{"headquarter":{"continent":"North America","country":"United States","state":"New York","city":"New York","street":"200 Hudson Street","postal_code":"10013","raw_address":"200 Hudson Street, New York, New York, United States, North America","position":{"lng":-73.98556,"lat":40.748295}},"locations":[{"continent":"North America","country":"United States","state":"New York","city":"New York","street":"200 Hudson Street","postal_code":"10013","raw_address":"200 Hudson Street, New York, New York, United States, North America","position":{"lng":-73.98556,"lat":40.748295}}]},"industries":["advertising services"],"keywords":["brand strategy","engagement planning & activation","mass media broadcast","content","direct cmr/ecrm","digital marketing","data & analytics","social marketing","experience design","events"],"languages":["english"],"sub_organizations":["0fff6a12-26e2-3074-0580-1730b2c4a330"],"naics":["541820","541810","541990"],"last_updated":"2026-06-13"},{"id":"2367e2db-7efe-71a2-367b-abf35e8e2bdb","summary":{"name":"Amplify","description":"Amplify is a global creative agency, specializing in experience, entertainment and culture. Head	quartered in London but operating all over the globe, Amplify also has hubs in Paris, LA, New York and Sydney and is globally B Corp certified. 

Named both ‘Brand Experience Agency of the Decade’ and 'Global Experience Agency of the Year', Amplify works with some of the world’s most forward-thinking and progressive brands including; Activision, Airbnb, Google, Lego, Netflix, Nike, Pinterest, PlayStation, Porsche and Spotify, creating campaigns and experiences that join the dots between people, brands and culture.
